entries.text: Aries Ascendant (Mesha Lagna): Ruled by Mars. Natural pioneers, energetic, direct, courageous, and ambitious. Sun (5th lord) and Jupiter (9th lord) are key functional benefics forming supreme Raja Yogas. Mercury (3rd/6th lord) is functionally malefic.

Taurus Ascendant (Vrishabha Lagna): Ruled by Venus. Grounded, practical, artistic, financially driven, and loyal. Saturn is the supreme Yogakaraka (ruling 9th and 10th houses), bestowing tremendous career rise and stability. Jupiter is functionally malefic (8th/11th lord).

Gemini Ascendant (Mithuna Lagna): Ruled by Mercury. Inquisitive, versatile, communicative, intellectual, and adaptable. Venus (5th/12th lord) is an auspicious functional benefic. Mars (6th/11th lord) acts as a powerful functional malefic requiring discipline.

Cancer Ascendant (Karka Lagna): Ruled by Moon. Deeply intuitive, emotionally receptive, protective, and family-oriented. Mars is the supreme Yogakaraka (ruling 5th and 10th houses), giving leadership, property, and career triumph. Jupiter (9th lord) brings spiritual fortune.

Leo Ascendant (Simha Lagna): Ruled by Sun. Authoritative, dignified, generous, charismatic, and natural leader. Mars is the Yogakaraka (ruling 4th and 9th houses), bringing real estate, power, and fortune. Jupiter (5th/8th lord) blesses intellect and purvapunya.

Virgo Ascendant (Kanya Lagna): Ruled by Mercury. Highly analytical, precise, detail-oriented, service-minded, and health-conscious. Venus (2nd and 9th lord) is the most auspicious planet, giving wealth and fortune. Mars (3rd/8th lord) is the primary malefic.

Libra Ascendant (Tula Lagna): Ruled by Venus. Diplomatic, balanced, refined, aesthetic, and relationship-centric. Saturn is the supreme Yogakaraka (ruling 4th and 5th houses), granting fixed assets, brilliant intellect, and long-term status.

Scorpio Ascendant (Vrishchika Lagna): Ruled by Mars. Intense, penetrating, secretive, transformative, and emotionally resilient. Jupiter (2nd/5th lord), Sun (10th lord), and Moon (9th lord) form powerful auspicious Raja and Dhana Yogas.

Sagittarius Ascendant (Dhanu Lagna): Ruled by Jupiter. Philosophical, optimistic, truth-seeking, expansive, and righteous. Sun (9th lord) and Mars (5th/12th lord) act as premier functional benefics, driving spiritual growth and higher learning.

Capricorn Ascendant (Makara Lagna): Ruled by Saturn. Ambitious, methodical, disciplined, enduring, and pragmatic. Venus is the supreme Yogakaraka (ruling 5th and 10th houses), bestowing creative brilliance, professional honors, and luxury.

Aquarius Ascendant (Kumbha Lagna): Ruled by Saturn. Visionary, humanitarian, unconventional, scientific, and egalitarian. Venus is the supreme Yogakaraka (ruling 4th and 9th houses), blessing the native with education, fixed property, and immense good fortune.

Pisces Ascendant (Meena Lagna): Ruled by Jupiter. Compassionate, imaginative, deeply spiritual, empathetic, and intuitive. Moon (5th lord) and Mars (2nd/9th lord) are highly auspicious, driving creative intuition, wealth, and spiritual wisdom.

Ashwini Nakshatra: Ashwini (0°–13°20' Aries): Ruled by Ketu, deity Ashwini Kumaras. Rapid healing, pioneering initiative, swift action, veterinary/medical skill, and transport.
Bharani Nakshatra: Bharani (13°20'–26°40' Aries): Ruled by Venus, deity Yama. Extreme creative power, capacity to bear heavy burdens, transformation, gynaecology, and artistic depth.
Krittika Nakshatra: Krittika (26°40' Aries – 10° Taurus): Ruled by Sun, deity Agni. Purification, cutting sharp intellect, culinary mastery, administrative leadership, and razor focus.
Rohini Nakshatra: Rohini (10°–23°20' Taurus): Ruled by Moon, deity Brahma. Seductive beauty, fertility, agricultural wealth, artistic grace, luxury trade, and creative design.
Mrigashira Nakshatra: Mrigashira (23°20' Taurus – 6°40' Gemini): Ruled by Mars, deity Soma. Searching curiosity, gentle nature, investigative intelligence, textile/travel arts, and research.

Ardra Nakshatra: Ardra (6°40'–20° Gemini): Ruled by Rahu, deity Rudra. Stormy emotional transformation, intellectual brilliance, computer programming, nuclear/biotech, and deep tears turning to triumph.
Punarvasu Nakshatra: Punarvasu (20° Gemini – 3°20' Cancer): Ruled by Jupiter, deity Aditi. Return of the light, forgiveness, renewal, archery/space travel, civil aviation, and spiritual restoration.

Pushya Nakshatra: Pushya (3°20'–16°40' Cancer): Ruled by Saturn, deity Brihaspati. The most auspicious nakshatra for nurturing, spiritual initiation, ethical mentorship, dairy/pharma, and lasting foundations.
Ashlesha Nakshatra: Ashlesha (16°40'–30° Cancer): Ruled by Mercury, deity Nagas. Hypnotic wisdom, psychological insight, venom-antidote medicine, secretive strategy, and esoteric mastery.
Magha Nakshatra: Magha (0°–13°20' Leo): Ruled by Ketu, deity Pitris. Royal throne, ancestral lineage power, administrative dignity, traditional ceremony, and leadership.
Purva Phalguni Nakshatra: Purva Phalguni (13°20'–26°40' Leo): Ruled by Venus, deity Bhaga. Relaxed pleasure, romance, fine arts, theatrical entertainment, musical joy, and social grace.
Uttara Phalguni Nakshatra: Uttara Phalguni (26°40' Leo – 10° Virgo): Ruled by Sun, deity Aryaman. Noble charity, honorable alliances, philanthropy, marriage contracts, and social responsibility.
Hasta Nakshatra: Hasta (10°–23°20' Virgo): Ruled by Moon, deity Savitur. Magic in the hands, craft mastery, surgical precision, astrology, healing touch, and commercial skill.
Chitra Nakshatra: Chitra (23°20' Virgo – 6°40' Libra): Ruled by Mars, deity Vishwakarma. Brilliant architectural design, sparkling glamour, sculpting, graphic artistry, and aesthetic mastery.
Swati Nakshatra: Swati (6°40'–20° Libra): Ruled by Rahu, deity Vayu. Independent freedom, business trade, aviation, diplomacy, flexibility, and pranayama mastery.
Vishakha Nakshatra: Vishakha (20° Libra – 3°20' Scorpio): Ruled by Jupiter, deity Indra-Agni. Focused determination, targeted ambition, triumphant goals, political alliance, and spiritual zeal.
Anuradha Nakshatra: Anuradha (3°20'–16°40' Scorpio): Ruled by Saturn, deity Mitra. Pure devotion, friendship, organizational networking, foreign travel success, and heart-centered bhakti.
Jyeshtha Nakshatra: Jyeshtha (16°40'–30° Scorpio): Ruled by Mercury, deity Indra. Seniority, protective authority, heroic courage, esoteric secrets, and high organizational command.
Mula Nakshatra: Mula (0°–13°20' Sagittarius): Ruled by Ketu, deity Nirriti. Root-level destruction and profound spiritual rebirth, botanical medicine, research, and non-attachment.
Purva Ashadha Nakshatra: Purva Ashadha (13°20'–26°40' Sagittarius): Ruled by Venus, deity Apas. Invincible victory, persuasive oratory, maritime commerce, philosophical depth, and natural charm.
Uttara Ashadha Nakshatra: Uttara Ashadha (26°40' Sagittarius – 10° Capricorn): Ruled by Sun, deity Vishwadevas. Unyielding integrity, permanent victory, institutional leadership, and statesman honor.
Shravana Nakshatra: Shravana (10°–23°20' Capricorn): Ruled by Moon, deity Vishnu. Deep listening, oral transmission of sacred knowledge, higher education, media, and scholarly learning.
Dhanishta Nakshatra: Dhanishta (23°20' Capricorn – 6°40' Aquarius): Ruled by Mars, deity Ashta Vasus. Musical rhythm, immense material wealth, martial discipline, and philanthropic renown.
Shatabhisha Nakshatra: Shatabhisha (6°40'–20° Aquarius): Ruled by Rahu, deity Varuna. Hundred physicians, enigmatic healing, space science, radar/telecom, solitude, and esoteric secrets.
Purva Bhadrapada Nakshatra: Purva Bhadrapada (20° Aquarius – 3°20' Pisces): Ruled by Jupiter, deity Aja Ekapada. Spiritual tapasya, transformative fire, philosophical passion, and occult vision.

Uttara Bhadrapada Nakshatra: Uttara Bhadrapada (3°20'–16°40' Pisces): Ruled by Saturn, deity Ahirbudhnya. Boundless wisdom, tranquil contemplation, charitable foundations, and spiritual enlightenment.
Revati Nakshatra: Revati (16°40'–30° Pisces): Ruled by Mercury, deity Pushan. Complete nourishment, safe journeys, animal care, poetic compassion, abundance, and spiritual ascension.
Gaja Kesari Yoga: Jupiter in Kendra (1, 4, 7, 10) from Moon. Endows noble character, permanent fame, wisdom, social authority, and protection from disasters.
Budhaditya Yoga: Sun and Mercury conjunct in same sign without deep combustion. Gives high academic brilliance, administrative acumen, sharp memory, and eloquence.
Ruchaka Yoga (Mahapurusha): Mars in Kendra in Aries, Scorpio, or Capricorn. Grants physical stamina, executive leadership, property wealth, military honors, and fearless courage.
Bhadra Yoga (Mahapurusha): Mercury in Kendra in Gemini or Virgo. Grants sharp intellect, versatile eloquence, business mastery, longevity, and academic distinction.
Hamsa Yoga (Mahapurusha): Jupiter in Kendra in Cancer, Sagittarius, or Pisces. Bestows profound spiritual wisdom, ethical purity, high advisory status, and public reverence.
Malavya Yoga (Mahapurusha): Venus in Kendra in Taurus, Libra, or Pisces. Bestows supreme aesthetic taste, marital bliss, luxurious vehicles, artistic success, and prosperity.
Sasa Yoga (Mahapurusha): Saturn in Kendra in Libra, Capricorn, or Aquarius. Bestows organizational power over masses, endurance, disciplined wealth, and lasting legacy.
Dharma-Karmadhipati Raja Yoga: 9th Lord and 10th Lord conjunct or in mutual aspect. Highest Raja Yoga connecting fortune and action; grants supreme societal honors.
Chandra-Mangal Yoga: Moon and Mars in conjunction or 7th mutual aspect. Ignites powerful commercial enterprise, financial resourcefulness, and self-earned wealth.
Lakshmi Yoga: 9th Lord exalted or in own house in Kendra/Trikona, and Venus well-placed. Bestows unshakeable prosperity, virtuous conduct, and royal grace.
Saraswati Yoga: Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury in Kendras/Trikonas/2nd house. Endows genius in creative arts, music, writing, sciences, and worldwide fame.
Amala Yoga: Benefic planet (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury) in the 10th house from Lagna or Moon. Grants unblemished character, honorable profession, and lasting prestige.
Harsha Vipareeta Raja Yoga: 6th Lord placed in 6th, 8th, or 12th house. Grants invincibility over rivals, victory in litigation, and robust physical resistance.
Sarala Vipareeta Raja Yoga: 8th Lord placed in 6th, 8th, or 12th house. Bestows fearlessness, long life, sudden windfall wealth, and supreme crisis mastery.
Vimala Vipareeta Raja Yoga: 12th Lord placed in 6th, 8th, or 12th house. Bestows financial independence, high ethical integrity, contentment, and spiritual freedom.
Neechabhanga Raja Yoga: Debilitated planet whose dispositor or exaltation lord is in Kendra from Lagna/Moon. Transforms initial hardships into grand lifetime success.
Parivartana Yoga (Maha): Mutual exchange of house lords between Kendra and Trikona houses. Supercharges both houses, granting phenomenal lifetime prosperity.
Durudhara Yoga: Planets (other than Sun/Rahu/Ketu) flanking Moon on both 2nd and 12th sides. Bestows emotional balance, wealth, and generous nature.
Sunapha Yoga: Planets in 2nd from Moon. Grants self-made wealth, pleasant speech, and joyful lifestyle.
Anapha Yoga: Planets in 12th from Moon. Bestows magnetic charm, clean character, good health, and broad-minded nature.
Vesi Yoga: Benefic in 2nd from Sun. Grants truthful speech, steady fortune, and distinguished status.
Vosi Yoga: Benefic in 12th from Sun. Bestows charitable nature, sharp memory, and peaceful mindset.
Ubhayachari Yoga: Benefics on both 2nd and 12th sides of Sun. Bestows all-around prosperity, royal recognition, and eloquence.
Kahala Yoga: 4th and 9th lords in mutual Kendras with strong Lagna lord. Bestows leadership of large teams, courage, and prominent status.
Shankha Yoga: 5th and 6th lords in Kendras with strong Lagna lord. Bestows humanitarian wealth, scholarship, and moral discipline.
Sun Mahadasha: Focus on career authority, father, government recognition, vitality, and leadership. Auspicious if Sun is strong; causes ego clashes if afflicted.
Moon Mahadasha: Focus on emotions, mother, public popularity, mental clarity, travel, and domestic expansion. Waxing Moon gives high happiness.
Mars Mahadasha: Focus on property, enterprise, physical stamina, leadership, siblings, and courage. Afflicted Mars requires careful conflict management.
Rahu Mahadasha: Brings sudden meteoric rises, international ventures, material ambitions, technological breakthroughs, and unconventional lifestyle shifts.
Jupiter Mahadasha: Golden period for children, higher education, spiritual wisdom, financial prosperity, moral honors, and philosophical fulfillment.
Saturn Mahadasha: Brings intense discipline, organizational duty, karmic maturation, perseverance, and solid long-term lifetime achievements.
Mercury Mahadasha: Focus on business commerce, intellectual publications, analytics, media networking, trade, and learning.
Ketu Mahadasha: Period of spiritual awakening, inward detachment, research, psychic intuition, and completion of karmic cycles.
Venus Mahadasha: Fabulous era for relationships, marriage, arts, luxury vehicles, domestic comforts, aesthetic success, and prosperity.

entries.text: Sade Sati (Setting Phase): Saturn transit in 2nd from Moon: Reorganizes financial resources, speech, family commitments, and establishes permanent stability.
Varna Koota (1 Point): Compares ego temperaments based on Moon signs. Ensures mutual spiritual respect and equality.
Vashya Koota (2 Points): Evaluates mutual magnetic attraction, dominance dynamics, and instinctual harmony.
Tara Koota (3 Points): Evaluates health, prosperity, longevity, and auspicious cosmic timing between birth nakshatras.
Yoni Koota (4 Points): Measures biological compatibility, intimacy, sexual attraction, and instinctual animal temperament.
Graha Maitri Koota (5 Points): Evaluates mental friendship, intellectual communication, and psychological compatibility of Moon sign lords.
Gana Koota (6 Points): Compares nature (Deva / Manushya / Rakshasa). Ensures shared social values, temperament, and domestic harmony.
Bhakoot Koota (7 Points): Evaluates emotional attachment, family welfare, and financial growth. 6/8 and 2/12 positions require remedies.
Nadi Koota (8 Points): Most vital koota evaluating genetic compatibility, progeny health, nervous system resonance, and longevity.
Kuja Dosha in both charts neutralizes marital friction. Mars in 1st, 2nd, 4th, 7th, 8th, or 12th matched with equal Mars ensures lifelong loyalty.
7th House Lord well-placed in Kendra/Trikona and aspected by Jupiter or Venus guarantees enduring affection and social respect in marriage.
D9 Navamsha chart reveals the soul of marriage. Venus and 7th Lord dignity in D9 determine inner marital contentment after age 28-30.
Upapada Lagna in mutual trines or quadrants with partner's Arudha Lagna (AL) indicates deep karmic bond and marital stability.
10th House represents Karma, authority, executive honors, and profession. Planets in 10th or aspecting 10th lord define the industry and public legacy.
D10 Dashamsha is the definitive divisional chart for professional achievement, career shifts, promotions, and societal status.
2nd House (accumulated wealth), 11th House (liquid gains/income), 5th & 9th Houses (purvapunya fortune) form the pillars of lasting financial prosperity.
Indu Lagna evaluated from Moon and 9th lords calculates extraordinary sudden financial prosperity and wealth magnitude.
6th House (Rogabhava) and Lagnesha vitality indicate immune strength, disease resistance, daily wellness habits, and recovery speed.
8th House (Ayurbhava) governed by Saturn (Ayushkaraka) determines longevity, transformative regeneration, and crisis endurance.
12th House, 9th House, and Rahu connections to Lagna/4th Lord indicate international relocations, global careers, and foreign settlement.
12th House, 8th House, 4th House (Moksha Trikona) with Ketu or Jupiter involvement indicate deep meditative illumination and spiritual enlightenment.
Sun Gemstone: 3–5 carats in Gold on right hand Ring Finger on Sunday morning. Boosts leadership, vitality, and career authority. Strictly avoid if Sun rules Dusthana (6/8/12).
Moon Gemstone: Natural South Sea Pearl in Silver on Little Finger on Monday evening. Calms anxiety, strengthens emotions and motherly bond.
Mars Gemstone: 6–8 carats in Copper/Gold on Ring Finger on Tuesday morning. Boosts physical stamina, courage, and property luck. Avoid if Mars is functional malefic.
Mercury Gemstone: 4–6 carats in Gold/Silver on Little Finger on Wednesday morning. Enhances communication, analytical coding, memory, and business commerce.
Jupiter Gemstone: 4–6 carats in Gold on Index Finger on Thursday morning. Bestows wisdom, wealth, marital grace, children, and spiritual protection.
Venus Gemstone: 1+ carat in Platinum/Silver on Middle or Ring Finger on Friday morning. Enhances aesthetic charm, artistic renown, and luxury comforts.
Saturn Gemstone: 4–6 carats in Silver on Middle Finger on Saturday evening. Must undergo 3-day trial. Bestows meteoric organizational rise, focus, and protection.
Rahu Gemstone: 5–7 carats in Silver on Middle Finger on Saturday. Clears confusion, enhances tech innovation and political strategy.
Ketu Gemstone: 4–6 carats in Silver on Little or Middle Finger on Tuesday. Protects against hidden psychic attacks, awakens spiritual intuition.
Supreme healing mantra: "Om Tryambakam Yajamahe Sugandhim Pushti-Vardhanam Urvarukamiva Bandhanan Mrityor Mukshiya Mamritat". Protects health, longevity, and dispels afflictions.
Solar illumination mantra: "Om Bhur Bhuva Swaha Tat Savitur Varenyam Bhargo Devasya Dheemahi Dhiyo Yo Nah Prachodayat". Awakens supreme intellect, inner light, and spiritual courage.
Recited on Tuesdays and Saturdays. Completely dissolves fear, panic, Manglik tension, Shani Sade Sati distress, and malicious planetary influences.
